text:
sam.exec: Heads-up — announcing GA for Hosted Bridge API today. This unifies streaming + tool orchestration under a single hosted endpoint. Big step for customers running interactive agents :tada:

nina.prod: TL;DR: new endpoint /v3/hosted-bridge, streaming frames, richer tool events, built-in fallback policies. Focused on predictable latency for chat/agent flows.

akash.eng: A few implementation notes from infra: bridge is an API-layer service that coordinates existing model runtimes. We did not change model kernels; we added a persistent bridge agent that manages tool subprocesses, event sequencing, and safe retries.

lisa.docs: Docs are live — migration guide, examples, and sample callbacks: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted-bridge/migrate. Also added 'best practices' section for long-lived streams and KV sizes.

akash.eng: Rolling strategy: internal opt-in -> progressive rollout by percentiles -> full GA after monitoring gates. Canary started at 1952101200.

sam.exec: Deprecation: old /v2/agents-tool endpoint will be supported for 60 days for reads and 90 days for writes. We'll send customers emails and in-product banners.

tom.sre: Monitoring: dashboard created for bridge p50/p95 latency, tool-error-rate, and stream connection churn. Alert thresholds: p95 > 500ms or tool-failure-rate > 2%. I've scheduled a quick rollback window if we see regressions.

lisa.docs: Migration example (curl streaming):
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v3/hosted-bridge \
  -d '{"model":"mosaicx-lite-2","prompt":"Run the lookup tool if you see a question","tools":[{"name":"lookup","url":"https://svc.internal/lookup"}],"stream":true}'
```

support-bot: KB created: https://internal.redwood/kb/hosted-bridge-ga \

nina.prod: Notes for Sales/CS: new pricing tier for bridge streaming calls (tokens + orchestration fee). Sales ops will have a migration playbook.

akash.eng: Known limitations: max concurrent tools per request = 5, stream idle timeout = 10m, tool call timeout = 60s. We'll iterate based on customer feedback.

sam.exec: Action items:
- ENG: monitor canary metrics for 72h (akash.eng, tom.sre)
- DOCS: add troubleshooting section for tool auth errors (lisa.docs)
- SUPPORT: prepare customer-facing migration emails (amy-support)

lisa.docs: Also adding code snippets for Node/Python SDKs and a small sample app.

akash.eng: Jenkins: bridge-service v1.0.0 deployed to hosted clusters at 1952101800. Health checks green.

sam.exec: Kudos to the team. We'll follow up with an executive note for customers later today. Ping here for urgent issues. :rocket:
